measurement: Native CLI --reference-basis --usage with standard panel and scoped recovery/cost/capacity breakdowns, through the repository triage; serialized native values. Same reference-check library as the accuracy dashboard. No second calculation run for this summary.
limits: Saved exporter values and pinned PoB2 are cross-checks, not game truth.
FullDPS is not calculated; damage uses selected main minion TotalDPS when its saved reference is nonzero.
Exporter-absent rules and timing models are disabled for reference comparison; focused native regressions cover the added rules.
Runtime errors fail triage, but numerical disagreement is reported rather than treated as a test failure.
Structural audit of this frozen corpus is separate; multi-set/historical/disabled/malformed import cases were not present in that corpus.
